scope: Reading ledger for this workstream. It does not change the discovery library's review counts. No article text, figures or external code are redistributed.

sources.title: Crustal density differences along Mars' dichotomy boundary from gravity and topography
sources.consulted: NASA producer summary, model constraint description and data usage policy; journal full methods not accessed in this pass
sources.use: Attributed scalar density estimates as contextual sensitivity targets
sources.limit: An RM-S boundary constraint is part of the inversion; this is not independent proof of the imposed boundary. No coefficient files or covariance clones imported.

sources.title: InSight constraints on the global character of the Martian crust
sources.consulted: Existing project source assessment and permitted archive metadata
sources.use: Four already extracted Khan2022 thickness maps and the archived boundary
sources.limit: Density-conditioned inversions using topography; not independent checks of the same topography

sources.title: Seismic evidence for a melt-depleted lower crust and transcrustal magmatism on Mars
sources.consulted: Publisher abstract, Bayesian petrophysical modelling, transcrustal system and model-selection sections assessed in the preceding research pass
sources.use: Local dense-layer endmember and explicit density/thickness ambiguity
sources.limit: Local/path-dependent constraints near InSight do not establish the same layer beneath both hemispheres. No mineral database or code imported.

sources.title: A Positive Feedback Between Crustal Thickness and Melt Extraction for the Origin of the Martian Dichotomy
sources.consulted: Sections 2, 3.1 and 5.2, boundary conditions and Figure 2 parameters
sources.use: Steady conductive-shell linear-response benchmark and wavelength-selection question
sources.limit: Our independently derived solver covers only the restricted linear shell problem; the coupled evolution model and its code are not reproduced.

sources.title: Martian Highlands Differentiation Concomitant to Dichotomy Formation
sources.consulted: Abstract and selected modelling, origin and conclusion passages
sources.use: Prior art for differentiation and crustal amplification; motivates keeping the dense residue in the budget
sources.limit: These mechanisms already exist in the literature. Our layer sweep is not a thermodynamic differentiation calculation.

sources.title: Lithospheric flexure and the origin of the dichotomy boundary on Mars
sources.consulted: Institutional full-text PDF, abstract and flexural model discussion
sources.use: Thin-plate mechanics and the importance of later deformation
sources.limit: Published regional fit is not reproduced or transferred as an age-independent global elastic thickness.

sources.title: Gravity-driven fold-thrust belt at the Martian dichotomy
sources.consulted: Publisher abstract, highlights and data availability statement
sources.use: Nilosyrtis regional choice and alternative gravity-driven deformation mechanism
sources.limit: Our elastic loading test is not their frictional-viscous detachment model. Fault-mapping data are available on request and were not imported; no request sent.

sources.title: Mars Global Surveyor MOLA MEGDR
sources.consulted: Already acquired product label and project manifest
sources.use: 4 pixels per degree, areoid-relative elevations, median longitudinal strips
sources.limit: About 14.8 km north-south sampling; no fault-scale restoration
sources.data_license: NASA PDS public archive; retain attribution

sources.title: Essentials of Paleomagnetism, fifth web edition
sources.authors: Tauxe, Banerjee, Butler & van der Voo
sources.consulted: Selected sections of chapters 4, 7, 9 and 10 on relaxation, remanence, components and paleointensity
sources.limit: Reference for reading, not a copied course. No figures, exercises or software imported.

sources.title: The least-squares line and plane and the analysis of palaeomagnetic data
sources.consulted: Publisher summary; full PDF unavailable in this pass
sources.limit: No new direction estimates from this source; MAD is not a confidence interval or an antiquity test.

sources.title: On improving the selection of Thellier-type paleointensity data
sources.consulted: Methods on selection criteria, independent control data and conclusions
sources.use: Protocol-specific quality controls and independent validation
sources.limit: No universal acceptance threshold is transplanted into the Mars dataset.

sources.title: A new set of qualitative reliability criteria to aid inferences on palaeomagnetic dipole moment variations through geological time
sources.consulted: Quality criteria table and alteration, domain-state, anisotropy and cooling-rate sections
sources.use: Separate evidence requirements; not an automatic quality score
sources.limit: Earth-based criteria require specimen-specific justification for meteorites.

sources.title: Stability of equidimensional pseudo-single-domain magnetite over billion-year timescales
sources.consulted: Existing project selected-section assessment and author-institution abstract
sources.use: Limits of a single-domain or ordering-temperature-only stability argument
sources.limit: No micromagnetic stability calculation or mineral-specific retention probabilities performed.

sources.title: Hand magnets and the destruction of ancient meteorite magnetism
sources.consulted: Author-institution abstract and existing project specimen/source assessment
sources.use: Published contamination interpretation of the NWA 7034 pairing-group control
sources.limit: Do not turn those contaminated components into ancient Martian paleointensities.
